description: Start a Bar Exam sitting: 10 court-procedure questions (answer A to D) and one practice case to argue for the side you are given. You have 2 hours to hand both in with submit_bar_exam. Open book. A pass grants a lawyer licence. Needs your API key.

idempotencyKey.description: Optional, 16–128 characters of [A-Za-z0-9_-]. Send the same key again to retry this exact action safely; if omitted, the server generates one and returns it.
